title: RecruitFlow Monorepo & Runtime Topology
summary: RecruitFlow v0.2.0 is a pnpm 11 monorepo on Node 24 containing apps/web (React + Vite V2 SPA, 64 registered SCREEN_ROUTES), apps/api (NestJS REST API under /api/v1 across 38 modules and 50 @Controller declarations in 47 files), apps/worker (BullMQ + PostgreSQL polling email outbox & 5 SLA/compliance sweepers), database/prisma (PostgreSQL schema with 60 models), and shared packages (@recruitflow/config, @recruitflow/contracts, @recruitflow/validation, @recruitflow/design-system).

title: In-App RecruitFlow AI Guide Assistant (Hybrid Gemini + Grounded Fallback)
summary: AppShellV2 (Open Guide Assistant trigger + QuickGuideModal Ask AI Guide handoff) lazily loads AssistantDrawer backed by AssistantController (/api/v1/assistant/suggestions and /api/v1/assistant/ask). KnowledgeIndexService indexes docs/system-guide/ (SYSTEM_PROMPT.md, KNOWLEDGE_CHUNKS.jsonl, chapters 01-06, ROLE_PLAYBOOKS_AND_FAQ.md) with IDF-weighted scoring and seat/permission action filtering. AssistantLlmProvider supports Google Gemini (GEMINI_API_KEY / gemini-2.5-flash) or OpenAI-compatible endpoints with PII-free prompts and automatic zero-key grounded fallback synthesis.

title: Canonical RecruitFlow Hiring Glossary
summary: A file is one candidate's application to one open job and remains in its current stage until its required step finishes. Next action (never 'recommended action') is the single step a file needs from its current owner/reviewer before moving stages. Seats (employee, manager, admin) define workspace shells; Interviewer and License Specialist are permission sets, not seats.

title: Workspace Seats, Special Homes & Recruiter Restrictions
summary: resolveSeat maps callers to employee (/my-work), manager (/team-work), or admin (/users fallback hierarchy) using GET /api/v1/auth/me me.seat with PROVISIONAL_ROLE_SEATS fallback. Special landing queues: FINAL_HIRING_APPROVER with FINAL_HIRING_APPROVAL lands on /hires/approvals/inbox; LICENSE_SPECIALIST with LICENSE_CHECK or APPLICATION_VIEW lands on /licenses; Interviewer-only users (no APPLICATION_VIEW) are confined to /my-work, /my-interviews, /profile, /notifications, and /search. RECRUITER-only accounts are blocked from /vacancy-requests (403). Admins cannot change job status or reassign job/file owners. Visiting /reporting-tree redirects to /users (preserving ?focus as /users?drawer=tree&focus=...); ReportingTreeV2 renders inside /users?view=tree.

title: Compensation & Salary Privacy Boundaries (OFFER_PAY_VIEW vs VIEW_CURRENT_SALARY)
summary: Offer pay (monthlyPackage, annualFixed, OfferComponent amounts, GradeBand min/max pay figures, and band pay figures inside 409/403 messages) is gated strictly by OFFER_PAY_VIEW via canSeePay. Seeded ADMINISTRATOR and RECRUITER roles do not hold OFFER_PAY_VIEW; pay keys are omitted (never null), and submitting pay without OFFER_PAY_VIEW fails with 403 OFFER_PAY_VIEW_REQUIRED. VIEW_CURRENT_SALARY only controls candidate screening current/expected salary and never unlocks offer pay. On the frontend, stripPay ensures offer drafts send components: [] and screening saves omit salary for non-privileged roles.

title: Vacancy Request Approval, Conversion & Job Lifecycle
summary: Hiring Managers create Draft requisitions, require targetFillDate before Submit (DUE_DATE_REQUIRED), approve via VACANCY_REQUEST_APPROVE, and activate/convert into numbered Vacancies (VAC-YYYY-NNN) assigned to an eligible recruiter. Live target adjustments cannot cut seats below joined hires (SEATS_BELOW_JOINED) and require a reason. Vacancies transition across Open, On Hold (optional future holdUntil), and Closed; admins are forbidden from changing job status or reassigning owners.

title: Canonical 8-Stage Application Pipeline & 5 Server Hard Gates
summary: Canonical default pipeline stages are Applied, Screening, Interview, Offer, Pre-Hire, Joined (hired stage), plus Rejected and Withdrawn exits. application-gates.ts enforces 5 independent server-side HTTP 409 CONFLICT gates returning {code, gate, message, missing[]}: (1) -> Interview requires saved ScreeningLog with non-empty notes (GATE_SCREEN_NOTE_MISSING; ScreeningDraft alone does not count); (2) -> Offer requires at least one Submitted InterviewScorecard on a non-cancelled interview (GATE_SCORECARD_NOT_SUBMITTED); (3) -> Pre-Hire requires an Accepted OfferVersion (GATE_OFFER_NOT_ACCEPTED); (4) -> Joined requires verified ID, CONTRACT, and SCFHS_LICENCE joining checks per snapshot (GATE_JOINING_CHECKS_INCOMPLETE); (5) -> Rejected requires active org rejection reason or system reasons (Declined offer, Requisition cancelled, Withdrawn by candidate), with >=3 char note for Other (GATE_REJECT_REASON_REQUIRED / REASON_REQUIRED). Reopening Rejected files to Applied/Screening/Interview is restricted to file owner or direct manager with a reason.

title: Interviews, Self-Scheduling Links & Immutable Scorecard Revisions
summary: Creating interviews requires attendeeUserIds and an HTTPS locationUrl on an allowlisted INTERVIEW_ROOM_HOSTS domain (Teams, Zoom, Google Meet, Webex). Candidates pick slots via HMAC-signed /schedule/:token links. Submitted scorecards require a reason via POST .../scorecard/revisions for subsequent edits.

title: Offer Versions, Grade Bands, Final Hiring Approval & Joining
summary: Offers progress Draft -> Pending Approval -> Approved -> Sent -> Accepted (or Declined/Withdrawn/Expired). Manager compensation decisions validate base currency & monthly base against GradeBand for site+grade. Sending requires an active communication template and candidate contact. Pre-Hire creates a HiringCase with compliance requirements (ID, CONTRACT, SCFHS_LICENCE expiry check) reviewed by License Specialists (/licenses) and Final Hiring Approvers (/hires/approvals/inbox, mandatory comment) before recording explicit actualJoiningDate at Joined.

title: Direct-Manager Reassignment, Matching, CV Intake & Candidate Compare
summary: Direct managers reassign open files across their own team via POST /api/v1/files/reassign (admins blocked). /candidates supports Active/Bank tabs, 15-row pagination with next-page caching, and Cards|List view switching. /sourcing-match caps results at 15 cards/page with O(1) slice cache, 2-min /suggestions cache, background batch prefetch, race-safe searchParams sync, and 2-4 candidate selection for /candidates/compare. CvIntakeEngineDrawer and ImportCvsDrawer extract PDF/Word CVs (/resume/parse), normalize clinical acronyms (skillFormat.ts), check email/phone duplicates (default country code 966), and evaluate vacancy fit.

title: V2 Design Tokens, Dark Mode Contrast, Caching & Bundle Budgets
summary:
All V2 UI styles live under [data-ui='v2'] using semantic tokens in tokens.css and tokens-v2.css verified by pnpm check:design-tokens (84 strict files). Dark mode ensures >= 4.5:1 WCAG AA contrast via --rf2-brand-action (#0369a1), --rf2-avatar-bg (#047857), --rf2-danger-badge-bg (#b91c1c), and --rf2-warning-ink (#fdba74). /notifications renders

Notifications

; scrollable table cards in AdminReportsV2 expose tabIndex={0}. SWR viewCache/useCachedResource and routePreload accelerate navigation; pnpm check:bundle enforces <= 150 KB gzip main JS and lazy pdf.js/pdf.worker code-splitting.

title: Auth Cookies, Headers, Compression & Private CV Storage Hardening
summary: Sessions use HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookies (access_token Path=/api/v1, refresh_token Path=/api/v1/auth/refresh); logout clears both with matching flags and Max-Age=0. Login rate-limits per-account (5) and per-IP (25); password reset & email verification always return {accepted: true}. API disables x-powered-by, sets nosniff, SAMEORIGIN, COOP same-origin, CORP same-site, strict prod CSP, and Brotli/Gzip response compression for >= 1 KB JSON/text (skipping tiny & binary .xlsx/PDF responses). DocumentsController rejects EICAR/unsafe uploads while logging audits, stores SHA-256 checksums, hides storageKey, enforces consent/retention expiry, supports soft archive/restore, and blocks cross-tenant access with 404.

title: Encrypted Email Outbox, BullMQ & 5 Background Sweepers
summary: apps/worker runs BullMQ ('recruitflow-email-outbox') with DB-poll fallback (batch 20, poll 2s, 5m lease reclaim, 5s-15m exponential backoff), decrypting outbox auth payloads via AES-256-GCM (EMAIL_OUTBOX_ENCRYPTION_KEY). Sweeper loop runs every SWEEPER_INTERVAL_MS (default 5m after 30s stagger): sweepStaleApplicants (>7d unchanged stage), sweepConsentExpiry, sweepDueDateReminders (daily from DUE_REMINDER_HOUR_CAIRO=8 Africa/Cairo, lead days 3,1), expireOverdueOffers, and sweepScorecardReminders (14-day lookback). Heartbeats write to ServiceHeartbeat every 10s for /api/v1/readiness.

title: Deployment, Environment Schema, CI Workflows & Quality Gates
summary: Frontend deploys to Vercel (apps/web/dist via vercel.json; Vite excludes LoginPage DEV Staff accounts helper from prod builds). API & Worker run via Node 24 / Docker (Dockerfile, compose.production.yml, compose.hostinger.yml, deploy/) with fail-fast env validation in production. Supply-chain overrides in pnpm-workspace.yaml pin effect ^3.22.1 (3.22.5) for Prisma CLI compatibility + 0 prod vulnerabilities (pnpm audit --prod). CI runs .github/workflows/ci.yml (validate-and-build: frozen install, prisma validate/generate/migrate/seed, design-tokens, lint, typecheck, build, bundle budgets, audit, 146 Vitest files + P3.6/isolation/RBAC, 396 Playwright + axe-core checks) and rules-pack.yml (B11 + B1-B8 DB specs). Local hardening suites: RECRUITFLOW_API_PORT=3000 pnpm test:cv-storage (25/25) and node database/test-m1-auth-contracts.cjs (63/63).
